subject: question related to input of data using shiny

messages.author: 3bcefa1ca39a6742
messages.subject: question related to input of data using shiny
parts:
Hello,

I am interested in seeing if I can use Shiny to input data into a database. I have created a tiny app to check how I might do this (here I am not yet using a database). The app is in

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/rdabbler/testForm

and the code is in gist:

https://gist.github.com/4410797

In this app, once I select "projects" in dropdown, I have an option of selecting "view projects" or "add projects". When I select  "add projects", the mainpanel shows a text box to add projects to an existing dataframe. To avoid changes as I am typing in the text box, I also have a drop down with choices ("Choose","Update") so that the reactive function runs only when the choice is set to "Update". That works fine. However after that, if I forget to set back the option to "Choose", then if I start typing something in the text box, it starts adding those to the data (which I don't want). Is there a way to automatically reset the option in the drop down to "Choose" in server.R after running the reactive function to add data.

The one option I was thinking of is using submit button but that is not convenient for the case where I want to generate reactiveUI (one drop down is generated based on choice of another dropdown). 

Also, if there are other ways of implementing inputs of form data, I would be interested in those too.

Thanks,
Shankar

messages.author: 3bcefa1ca39a6742
messages.subject: Re: question related to input of data using shiny
parts:
Hi,

Just an update to my previous post. After seeing the posts related to actionButton in shinyIncubator in this discussion group, I modified my app to use that. That seems to help. The version of the small app with action buttons is in the following link:

http://glimmer.rstudio.com/rdabbler/testForm_new/

Here one has to click the actionButton to add or modify a project in the underlying table. Since the actionButton counter keeps increasing, I used another global variable that I reset each time so that data is sent to table only when I click the button again. The full code is uploaded in gist:

https://gist.github.com/4424361

I am interested in knowing if there is a better way to implement this. Also, is there a way to change the color of the action button.

Thanks,
Shankar
